precision_comparison_limit: The historical FP16 run used context/slot 9216, batch 512, ubatch 128 and 16 GPU layers. New Q4 uses the original Qwen settings: context/slot 12288, batch 16384, ubatch 2048; GPU offloading remains the same binary's default. The FP16/Q4 contrast is descriptive and is not an isolated causal precision effect.

methods.bootstrap: Original E01: represented base_interval_id clusters, 10000 draws, PCG64 seed42, linear percentile 95%; task-weighted mean
methods.icc: ICC(2,1): two-way random-effects absolute agreement, single measurement; negative values retained
methods.originals: Each phase separately; unique film_id/scene_id within phase, never pooled across phases
methods.rewrites: Group/task_id/source_film_id/scene_id, valid paired scores independently of TI eligibility
methods.source_curves: Each base interval once per feature and phase; median defined Spearman coefficients
methods.target_direction: Native _resample and signum, six-decimal original values; source and reference use each extractor's own scores
